mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND disabled = 0 AND frozen = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND disabled = 1 AND frozen = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN frozen = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS frozen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected FROM t_farm WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'NORMAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'DISABLED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabled, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{monthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS new_this_month FROM t_user WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uad.user_id) FROM t_user_active_day uad JOIN t_user u ON u.id = uad.user_id AND u.status = 'NORMAL' WHERE uad.stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND uad.op_count > 0) AS users_7d, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uad.user_id) FROM t_user_active_day uad JOIN t_user u ON u.id = uad.user_id AND u.status = 'NORMAL' WHERE uad.stat_date = #{today} AND uad.op_count > 0) AS users_today, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uad.farm_id) FROM t_user_active_day uad JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = uad.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND f.disabled = 0 AND f.frozen = 0 WHERE uad.stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND uad.record_count > 0 AND uad.farm_id > 0) AS farms_7d

SELECT c.species AS species, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_farm f JOIN t_category c ON c.id = f.main_category_id WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.audit_status = 'APPROVED' GROUP BY c.species ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT 'FARM_AUDIT' AS type, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS rejected, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN audited_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, submitted_at, audited_at) / 3600.0 END), 1) AS avg_handle_hours FROM t_farm_audit WHERE audited_at >= #{monthStart} AND audited_at <= #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'FARM_CHANGE', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN audited_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, audited_at) / 3600.0 END), 1) FROM t_farm_change WHERE audited_at >= #{monthStart} AND audited_at <= #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'CHANGE_REQUEST', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN reviewed_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, submitted_at, reviewed_at) / 3600.0 END), 1) FROM t_change_request WHERE reviewed_at >= #{monthStart} AND reviewed_at <= #{now} UNION ALL SELECT 'ACCOUNT_RECOVERY', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN handled_at IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, created_at, handled_at) / 3600.0 END), 1) FROM t_account_recovery WHERE handled_at >= #{monthStart} AND handled_at <= #{now}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'APPROVED' AND frozen = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN audit_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN frozen = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS frozen FROM t_farm WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status <> 'REJECTED' AND LEFT(adcode, LENGTH(#{adcodePrefix})) = #{adcodePrefix}
SELECT CASE LENGTH(#{adcodePrefix}) WHEN 2 THEN MAX(province) WHEN 4 THEN MAX(city) ELSE MAX(district) END FROM t_farm WHERE deleted = 0 AND LEFT(adcode, LENGTH(#{adcodePrefix})) = #{adcodePrefix}

SELECT f.id AS farm_id, a.id AS audit_id, f.name AS farm_name, c.name AS category_name, a.submitted_at AS submitted_at, a.submit_no AS submit_no FROM t_farm_audit a JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = a.farm_id AND f.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = f.main_category_id WHERE a.status = 'PENDING' AND LEFT(f.adcode, LENGTH(#{adcodePrefix})) = #{adcodePrefix} ORDER BY a.submitted_at ASC, a.id ASC LIMIT 20

SELECT stat_date AS stat_date, CASE #{metric} WHEN 'ACTIVE_USER' THEN active_user_count WHEN 'NEW_USER' THEN new_user_count ELSE production_record_count END AS value FROM t_platform_daily_stat WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT stat_date AS stat_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS value FROM t_user_active_day WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND op_count > 0 GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT DATE(created_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM t_user WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < DATE_ADD(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY stat_date
SELECT stat_date AS stat_date, COALESCE(SUM(record_count), 0) AS value FROM t_user_active_day WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date
